item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Reaches fresh three-month highs above 1.3550
item.description: GBP/USD extends its gains for the second successive session, trading around 1.3560 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates a persistent bullish bias. The 14-day Relative Strength Index (RSI) reached 69.29, near overbought.

item.title: Australian Dollar rises as US Dollar weakens, hawkish RBA tone
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) advances against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday following two days of gains. Traders await Australia's November Consumer Price Index (CPI) release due on Wednesday.

item.title: CES 2026: Nvidia’s playbook for the next phase of AI
item.description: CES, the annual Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas, is a major annual showcase for technology products and platforms. For markets, it is a useful signal on where innovation spending and commercial adoption may be heading.

item.title: Pound Sterling Price News and Forecast: GBP/USD hit a fresh three-month high of 1.3562
item.description: GBP/USD extends its gains for the second successive session, trading around 1.3560 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates a persistent bullish bias. The 14-day Relative Strength Index (RSI) reached 69.29, near overbought.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Looks set for fresh rally above 212.20
item.description: The GBP/JPY pair posts a fresh multi-year high at 212.15 during the Asian trading session on Tuesday.

item.title: USD/INR drops as safe-haven demand of US Dollar diminishes
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades positively against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday after a three-day losing streak. The USD/INR pair corrects to near 90.35 as the US Dollar Index (DXY) falls back sharply after posting a fresh over-a-three-week low at 98.86 on Monday.

item.title: EUR/GBP flat lines near 0.8650 ahead of German CPI inflation release
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross trades on a flat note near 0.8655 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday.

item.title: Japanese Yen bulls seem noncommittal amid BoJ uncertainty, fiscal concerns
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) seesaws between tepid gains/minor losses against a softer US Dollar (USD) and, for now, seems to have stalled its recovery move from a nearly two-week low, touched the previous day.

item.title: Gold retreats slightly from one-week high; holds above $4,450 amid bullish outlook
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) retreats slightly from a one-week high, touched earlier this Tuesday, and trades with only modest intraday gains, above the $4,450 level, heading into the European session.
